origin: Original frozen C API, original GGUF writer and scalar quantizers. Expected data is never generated by the Rust implementation.

contract.graph: Frozen Falcon NeoX RoPE, F32 contiguous KV, one worker, nonflash, full head RoPE, parallel FFN, optional second affine norm. Any failing comparison must be diagnosed before changing this contract.

scope: 22 executable synthetic variants,14 checked rejection/unsupported boundaries. This corpus does not establish pretrained Falcon quality, flash, scaled RoPE, per-layer arrays, noncausal inference or full native C contexts.
